title: Microsoft Agent Framework Overview
summary: Official overview of Microsoft Agent Framework. Unifies AutoGen's agent abstractions with Semantic Kernel's enterprise session management, type safety, telemetry, and middleware, adding graph workflows. Designates Agent Framework as the direct successor to AutoGen and Semantic Kernel.
